inventory.description: 8204 traffic incident records from Bengaluru. Contains event_type (planned/unplanned), lat/long, event_cause (vehicle_breakdown, tree_fall, accident, etc.), road_closure flag, start/end timestamps, priority, corridor, zone, junction, police_station. Rich geospatial + temporal + categorical data.

298449 police violation records. Contains lat/long, vehicle_number, vehicle_type, violation_type (WRONG PARKING, NO PARKING, etc.), offence_code, junction_name, police_station. Primarily parking violations data. Could also serve Computer Vision theme but no images included.
